profile.subtitle: Your name, contact details, and how teammates see you.

personal_info.title: Personal information
personal_info.help: Your name and contact details. Visible to teammates inside your workspace.

profile.editing_coming_soon: Editing controls are coming soon. For now this view is read-only.

account.subtitle: Email, password, and active sessions for your sign-in.

email.title: Sign-in email
email.help: The email address you use to sign in. Used for password resets and login notifications.

password.title: Password
password.help: Change your password. We'll ask for your current password and require a new one entered twice.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.help: Sessions you're currently signed in from. Sign-out-everywhere coming soon.
sessions.empty: No session list yet — this section is a placeholder.

billing.subtitle: Subscription, payment method, and invoice history for this workspace.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.help: Your workspace's plan and renewal date. Billing applies to the whole workspace, not individual users.
subscription.empty: No active subscription — billing flow is not yet wired.

payment_method.title: Payment method
payment_method.help: The card or account we charge for your subscription.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.help: Past invoices and receipts, downloadable as PDF.

preferences.subtitle: Theme, density, notifications, and language preferences.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.help: Theme, density, and font. Existing controls live in the header theme switcher; this page consolidates them.
appearance.empty: Inline appearance controls are not yet wired here — use the theme switcher in the top header for now.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.help: Choose which events deliver an email or in-app notification.

language_region.title: Language & region
language_region.help: Display language, date format, and timezone defaults.
